# SourceCard

A card for one data source (Browser extension, VS Code, Desktop agent, LMS) in one of three states: not connected, waiting with a pairing code, or connected.

`CLR.SourceCard` · Onboarding

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.SourceCard kind={…} state={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.SourceCard" kind="{{…}}" state="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `'browser' \| 'vscode' \| 'desktop' \| 'lms'` |  |
| `state` * | `'not_connected' \| 'waiting' \| 'connected'` |  |
| `code` | `string` | Pairing code while waiting, e.g. "H2M-9PX". |
| `codeExpiresIn` | `number` | Seconds the code stays valid. |
| `lastSeen` | `string` | "12s ago". |
| `recommended` | `boolean` |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |
| `onConnect` | `() => void` |  |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` |  |
| `onDisconnect` | `() => void` |  |
